Harper: Tiny update 1 big news 1 I got promoted to Principal Product Designer today and also we
re expecting a baby in September. Felt weirdly like two emails that deserve cupcakes. :tada: :baby: 
Eli: WHOA congrats Harper!! Principal PD and baby on the way? Thatalls for a calendar-blocking party. Pics of your celebration snacks pls. :cake:
Harper: Thank you!! Celebratory croissant at my desk right now. Also we
id a silly at-home gender-reveal cake (itxploded confetti) so pics later. 
June: Massive congrats!! Quick poll: should we do a baby gender-reveal coffee run at 3pm or a classic cake at 4pm in the kitchen? React :one: for coffee, :two: for cake.
Riley: :two: cake. Also can we get a gluten-free option? 
People Ops Bot: @harper congrats on the promotion and the baby! I created a 20-min "Harper: promo + baby" event at 4:00pm in the kitchen with a GF cake option. Please RSVP and indicate dietary needs here: https://forms.company/celebrate-harper (auto-reminder 3:30pm).
Sam: Also vote on the name reveal style: write the name on a tiny whiteboard, confetti poppers, or a silly hat? React :one: whiteboard, :two: poppers, :three: hat.
Eli: :two: Poppers for max drama. I will bring napkins and a camera.
Nina: Congrats Harper!! If you want help with a registry post or a short slide for All-Hands, I can draft something. Also sending you a little plant for the nursery. :seedling:
Harper: Thank you everyone 1 I
ppreciate the help. Poppers it is. Also if anyone has tiny baby onesies in neutral colors to lend for photos, tag me. Pictures & a dramatic GIF incoming. https://giphy.com/gifs/baby-announcement-3o7aD2saalBwwftBIY :heart:
